===== PROBE =====
name: pcie.iommu_cmdline
started_utc: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
root_mode: none
run_as: root
requires: /proc/cmdline
timeout_s: 120
runner: timeout -k 5 120 bash -o pipefail -c <command>
===== COMMAND =====
grep -oE '...' /proc/cmdline || [ $? -eq 1 ]
===== STDOUT =====
amd_iommu=on
iommu=pt
===== STDERR =====
===== RESULT =====
exit_code: 0
duration_s: 0.010
